name: react-native-best-practices
headline: Autobe: AI Coding Agent for TypeScript Development
short_description: Autobe is an AI-powered coding agent designed for TypeScript backend development. It automates code generation with 100% working outputs, using advanced compiler skills for integration and efficiency.
author: wrtnlabs

sections.overview:
Autobe is a specialized AI coding agent designed for TypeScript backend development automation. It generates code with compiler-driven validation to ensure quality and correctness, eliminating manual verification steps. The agent integrates advanced compiler skills to catch errors during generation rather than after, reducing iteration cycles. It's built for developers who need reliable, production-ready TypeScript code without extensive review cycles. Autobe works with AI code editors like Claude Code and Cursor to streamline backend development workflows.
Automate the creation of RESTful APIs for web applications using simple natural language prompts.
Generate boilerplate code for NestJS applications, reducing initial setup time significantly.
Design and implement database schemas with Prisma, ensuring type safety and consistency.
Create comprehensive documentation for APIs and databases automatically, enhancing team collaboration.
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`claude install wrtnlabs/autobe`
`git clone https://github.com/wrtnlabs/autobe`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
